name: AIMotionTokens
description: Semantic motion aliases on AI.motion.icon.* for the Motion Icon treatment layer. Used only when state requires emphasis; default is no motion.
intent: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use semantic motion names — pulse, spin, shimmer, nudge, handoff, completion, alertRing.

notes: No motion >5s without user pause control
Static fallbacks: show percent label or status text without animation

forbiddenUsage: Do not hand-tune duration or easing per component
Do not use decorative parallax in chat
Do not animate layout height on every streamed token append
agentRules: Read motion.json for icon motion, keyframes, and transitions
Default is no motion — only fire for loading, handoff, completion, alert
